build_registry: build a registry using setup_registry with a name, base class, and default value
register_class: register a class in the registry using the register_x decorator returned by setup_registry
build_from_registry: build an instance from the registry using the build_x function with argparse args
review_setup_registry: review the setup_registry function to understand how it creates build and register helpers
summarize_REGISTRIES: summarize the global REGISTRIES dictionary that tracks all created registries and their defaults
